title: Pattern Queue Age by Craft Type
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:project project_status="queued"
| stats max(days_in_queue) as max_days_in_queue, count as queued_projects by craft_type
| sort - max_days_in_queue
description: Shows how long queued knitting, crochet, or sewing projects have been waiting to start.
value: Queue age is a healthy antidote to aspirational over-planning because it reveals the oldest neglected intentions.
implementation: Export queued Ravelry project metadata with craft type and the number of days since it entered the queue.
visualization: Table of craft types with queued project count and oldest queue age.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which kinds of craft projects have been waiting the longest to get started.
